== Summary ==
The Star Wars CCG Players Committee organization chart (one page, "Star Wars CCG Players Committee &ndash; Organization Chart"), rendered at 300 dpi from the PDF created on 6 May 2024 (PDF author metadata: Jared Napolitano).

== Source ==
* Original PDF: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf]
* Archived copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine, captured 10 October 2026] (the file is byte-identical to the live PDF of that date)

Used on [[Players Committee organization]].
